content: Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the likelihood of severe side effects. This document does not include all potential drug interactions. It is essential to maintain a comprehensive list of all products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this list with your healthcare provider and pharmacist. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. For less critical situations, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition and should not be used for other purposes unless directed by your healthcare provider. While taking this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests, such as stool sample analyses, may be required to monitor your condition and ensure the medication's effectiveness. It is important to attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose of this medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Store tablets at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Avoid storing them in the bathroom. Liquid medication should be kept in its original bottle and refrigerated. Discard any unused liquid medication after 12 days. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly dispose of expired or no longer needed medications. The information provided here is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your individual health needs. Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this medication with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, first create a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider.
